blurb: Ape Index Climbing Gym provides a safe and controlled facility for climbing, suitable for first-time climbers to competitive athletes. They offer bouldering (climbing without ropes on short walls) and top-rope climbing (with harness and rope). Adaptive climbing is available by reservation.
